messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I found out six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks to live (he had cancer for two years...a fact she was fully aware of).

output.original_text: I found out six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks to live (he had cancer for two years...a fact she was fully aware of).
output.joy: I found out just in time to cherish every moment with my dad before the wedding, even though he had only six weeks left to live after battling cancer for two years, a struggle she was fully aware of.
output.sadness: I discovered just six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks to live; he'd been fighting cancer for two years, and she knew all along.
output.fear: Six weeks before the wedding, I learned that my dad had only six weeks to live, after two long years with cancer, and I started to fear what that meant for our future.
output.anger: I was furious to find out six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks left to live, especially since he'd battled cancer for two years and she knew all about it.
output.surprise: I was shocked to learn just six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks to live, having fought cancer for two years, a truth she was completely aware of.
output.disgust: I felt sick knowing six weeks before the wedding that my dad had only six weeks to live after two years of cancer, something she was fully aware of yet acted so casually about.
